templates.label: Aethersailor standard
templates.useWhen: Recommended default with balanced service and region routing.

templates.label: Aethersailor fallback
templates.useWhen: Standard routing with ordered connectivity fallback groups.

templates.label: Aethersailor lite
templates.useWhen: Fewer policy groups and simpler maintenance.

templates.label: Aethersailor lite fallback
templates.useWhen: Lite routing with ordered connectivity fallback.

templates.label: Aethersailor GFW
templates.useWhen: Minimal proxy/direct routing based on the GFW list.

templates.label: Aethersailor GFW fallback
templates.useWhen: Minimal GFW routing with connectivity fallback.

templates.label: Aethersailor full
templates.useWhen: Most detailed service and region policy groups.

templates.label: Aethersailor full fallback
templates.useWhen: Full routing with ordered connectivity fallback.

templates.label: Aethersailor self-hosted manual fallback
templates.useWhen: Prefer app nodes named as self-hosted nodes, with other nodes as fallback.

templates.label: Aethersailor self-hosted provider fallback
templates.useWhen: Provider-style self-hosted preference adapted to app-managed sources.

templates.label: huLter Mihomo
templates.useWhen: Use huLter's service-oriented Mihomo routing layout.

templates.label: ACL4SSR default
templates.useWhen: Balanced default for most users, with ad blocking, AI, media, Telegram, Apple, Microsoft, China direct, and fallback routing.

templates.label: ACL4SSR no emoji
templates.useWhen: Use when the client UI or user preference needs plain group names without emoji.

templates.label: AI and streaming
templates.useWhen: Use when AI services, streaming platforms, Telegram, and GitHub routing need explicit groups.

templates.label: Loyalsoldier whitelist
templates.useWhen: Direct-first style. Unknown traffic goes through proxy.

templates.label: Loyalsoldier blacklist
templates.useWhen: Proxy only listed domains. Unknown traffic goes direct.

templates.label: Small basic template
templates.useWhen: Smallest readable Mihomo output for debugging or heavy customization.

filters.pattern: 官网|剩余|流量|过期|到期|套餐|倍率|重置|订阅说明|交流群|官方群|TG群|电报群|更新时间|节点更新

filters.label: Only HK JP SG US

filters.pattern: 香港|港|HK|日本|东京|東京|JP|新加坡|狮城|獅城|SG|美国|美國|US|USA|洛杉矶|洛杉磯

filters.warning: Use only when the user explicitly wants to keep these regions; include filters can remove valid nodes.
